audit.whatIsWrong: The chart handed Fiora five of seven stages in a lane Heimerdinger wins 55.49%, and the full layer said 'His early — survive to your spikes' while the content layer said levels 2-5 are Heimerdinger's zone.
audit.why: Lunge is 400 range on 13s at rank 1 — Fiora has to spend her only gap-closer just to reach a minion inside two turret beams. The mirror set Skill / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Skill / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger as one atomic group.
audit.corrected: Chart aligned to the mirror on both layers, ratings moved with it, difficulty re-rated 6/10 to agree with the FAV label.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags that the page never names a single Fiora ability; every phase row was template text.
audit.why: Lunge 13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6s at 400, Riposte 24/22/20/18/16s at 750, Bladework 11/10/9/8/7s, Grand Challenge 110/90/70s at 500. Heimerdinger's own CH-2 is a flat 11s, so the grenade is up more often than her parry from rank 1.
audit.corrected: Every phase row now names the ability and cooldown that owns that stage, and the 11s-versus-24s comparison drives the bait-then-stun sequencing.

audit.whatIsWrong: The grenade was called 'CH-3X' and 'CH-3X Lightning Grenade' with a 'center-stun'; turret beams were called slowing electron beams; and the page said Riposte 'parries' without stating what it gives her back.
audit.why: Heimerdinger's E is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade — 11s flat, 970 range, stunning only the direct hit. The turret's secondary attack is a pass-through beam with no slow. Riot's Riposte text is decisive here: it parries all incoming damage and, if it blocks an immobilizing effect, the follow-up stab stuns instead of slowing — so a grenade thrown into a held parry hands Fiora a stun on you.
audit.corrected: Bait Riposte onto a rocket spread or turret beam, then land CH-2's direct hit; never lead the grenade into a held parry.

audit.whatIsWrong: The itemization line said 'his healing' and never connected anti-heal to vitals.
audit.why: Duelist's Dance heals her on every vital hit and Grand Challenge heals her and nearby allies after the vitals land, so Grievous Wounds is what makes turret chip stick. Lunge also applies on-hit effects, so her damage scales with attack speed rather than raw AD.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal early against vital healing; read her trades as on-hit damage, not pure AD.

edits.before: This is my window. Levels 4-5 with a full three-turret nest and the CH-3X Lightning Grenade, any Fiora all-in is suicide — she dashes in, eats the center-stun, and three beams plus a W-rocket spread delete her while she's locked. The one trap: her W can parry (and stun back) a key cast, so never lead with the grenade into a held parry. Bait the parry onto a rocket spread or turret beam, THEN land the center-stun and collapse the nest on her. At 6 her R is her cleanest dive, but UPGRADE!!! answers it with a super-turret or a wider, longer-stunning grenade — make her commit into the buildings, not in open lane.
edits.after: This is my window. Levels 4-5 with a full three-turret nest and the CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, any Fiora all-in is suicide — she dashes in, eats the direct-hit stun, and three beams plus a W-rocket spread delete her while she's locked. The one trap: Riposte parries all damage for its duration and stuns you back if it blocks an immobilize, so never lead with the grenade into a held parry — it is 24s at rank 1. Bait it onto a rocket spread or turret beam, THEN land the direct hit. At 6 Grand Challenge is her cleanest dive, but UPGRADE!!! answers it — make her commit into the buildings.
